source_call_path: TimelineEditor.tsx imports TimelineEditorCore.tsx; Core mounts useClipDrag; ClipAction exposes clip and row identity.

useClipDrag pointer-down admission -> pending session with original moveReadBasis -> threshold/coordinator plan -> pointer-up commitDraggingSession -> ops.applyResolvedClipMove (or moveClipToRow fallback).
useTimelineState binds real upstream trackManagement ops. applyResolvedClipMove calls save.applyEdit with rows plus gestureBasis. useTimelineSave delegates non-element edits to useTimelineCommit.

useTimelineCommit materializes rows and emits scheduleSave; useTimelineSave subscribes persistence.scheduleSave; persistence captures localDocumentSave before debounce and awaits localCapture before flush.

useTimelineSave.capture clones input/basis and awaits the original owner handoff. timelineLocalSaveHandoff validates the original physical/source/gesture basis, preserves the child closure, and appends a guarded document intent.
localSaveSession.appendDocument validates before bytes, persists the original intent with predecessor; flush/pump builds the v2 doc.patch request and calls shared commitOutbox.dispatch.
commitOutbox reserves pending exact body and Idempotency-Key in a completed readwrite transaction before transmit; localSaveSession send delegates provider.commitTimeline.

commitSession.ts move capture port is a separate command-session route; the current upstream parent row gesture is wired through localSaveSession, not that port. ADD uses ordinary command-session options.send; placement may use operation.transmit.
guarantees_untouched: Original dependent intent operands/reads/IDs remain persisted; only ready base advances after predecessor acceptance.
Canonical result is adopted before dependent replay; refused prefix and descendants remain retained while visible preview rolls back with conflict/error state.
Exact pending bytes survive retry; authoritative accepted/merged/refused results, history and guarded Undo have no modifications. These are source facts, not fresh end-to-end qualification.
